props.name: items
props.description: The items to be used. The items will be used in the given array order.

props.name: itemsPerPage
props.description: The number of items per page (at most).

props.name: itemsLength
props.description:
The number of items to be used.

Used together with `fetchData`.

bindings.name: items
bindings.description: The items on the current page.

bindings.name: numberOfItems
bindings.description: The number of items on the current page.

bindings.name: currentPage
bindings.description: The number of the current page.

bindings.name: firstItemIndex
bindings.description: The index of the first item on the current page.

bindings.name: lastItemIndex
bindings.description: The index of the last item on the current page.
